input.reason: The claim asserts a specific numerical result (completion time of 12 ms under fixed configuration A), but the previous feedback confirms that the authors' dataset is absent and no archived artifact or measurement input is available. Without the original data, configuration specification, or any measurement input, it is impossible to design a reproducible check. The registered runners (emulated-netem-v1, real-world-iperf-v1) could in principle measure flow completion times, but "configuration A" is undefined — no parameters (topology, link rates, RTT, queue sizes, flow sizes, number of flows, protocol, etc.) have been supplied. Additionally, the source is described as a synthetic evaluation packet with no real paper reviewed, so there is no authoritative specification to extract configuration details from. Two blockers are identified: (1) missing data for the original measurement/dataset, and (2) missing data for the complete specification of "configuration A."

blockers.detail: The authors' original dataset or measurement artifact is absent. No recorded completion-time observations are available to compare against the claimed 12 ms value.
blockers.required_input: Original measurement data or archived artifact containing the flow completion time observations under configuration A.

blockers.detail: 'Configuration A' is referenced but never defined. Without the full parameter specification (topology, link capacity, propagation delay, queue discipline/size, flow size, number of concurrent flows, transport protocol, congestion control algorithm, etc.), no faithful reproduction or emulation can be designed.
blockers.required_input: Complete specification of configuration A, including all network and workload parameters needed to reproduce the experiment.
